name: Suki da yo, Kuroda-kun!
source:
The protagonist is a junior in high school. Ever since she was a freshman, she was curious about Kuroda, and now, they're in the same class! Turns out Kuroda's a man of few words, so she's having a hard time trying to get to know him. One day, on her way home, she spots Kuroda. Since he's also the type to be the first out the door after class, she sees this as an opportunity to get closer to him, but...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27329]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名高二学生。她从高一开始就在意黑田，如今终于和他分到了同一个班！可黑田是个沉默寡言的人，她始终找不到机会了解他。一天，主人公在回家途中看见了黑田。他平时总是一放学就第一个离开教室，她觉得这是拉近距离的好机会，可是……
